verdict.rationale: The docs say you can 'stream text while the model processes the file', but nothing in the evidence shows streamed results labeled as interim versus final, or any documentation of finality semantics. Community streaming reports concern the third-party whisper.cpp port and Buzz, not documented interim/final semantics of this product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, streaming results distinguish interim from final transcripts, with the finality semantics documented
